entries.text: Forgive me, my friends...[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_dokuboss_00

entries.text: About a year and a half ago...
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_system_01

entries.text: Forgive me. It took a goodly time to procure\nthe required materials.[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_dokuboss_01

entries.text: Whoaaa, sick! These boots are insaaaaaane![VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_honooboss_01

entries.text: Ah, yes. The move Flame Charge was my muse\nfor those particular pieces.[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_dokuboss_02

entries.text: This outfit is everything I imagined it would be.\nThank you so much![VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_kakutouboss_01

entries.text: I merely wished to create a costume worthy of\nthe great Infernal Eri. If it aligns with your vision,\r\nthen I am content.[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_dokuboss_03

entries.text: Seems our outfit upgrades are all wrapped up,\nthen! Thanks a ton, Atticus.[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_akuboss_01

entries.text: With you two lookin’ like absolute beasts,\nanyone who crosses us will be sweatin’ bullets![VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_akuboss_02

entries.text: You’re so good at these sorts of crafty things,\nAtticus.[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_fairyboss_01

entries.text: Those people bullying you ’cause you geek out\nover old-fashioned stuff are out of their minds.[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_fairyboss_02

entries.text: The way of the ninja is rough and fraught with\nthorns. I neither expect nor desire sympathy from\r\nthe unrefined rabble.[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_dokuboss_04

entries.text: Oooh, someone’s gettin’ fired up! Watch out,\nworld—our Atticus has FIGHTIN’ words![VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_honooboss_02

entries.text: Yeah, don’t listen to the haters, Atticus. I think\nyou’re really cool![VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_kakutouboss_02

entries.text: All right, gang. Let’s move on to the next step.\c\nIt’s time to put our backs into our battle training\nso we’re all prepped for Operation Star.[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_akuboss_03

entries.text: We gotta be stronger than everyone else in the\nteam—that’s what bein’ a boss means![VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_akuboss_04

entries.text: Indeed it does. Henceforth, I will devote myself\nheart and soul to honing my battle skills![VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_dokuboss_05

entries.text: For the sake of the team, I would give my very\nheart and soul...but I cannot defy the rules.[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_dokuboss_06

entries.text: Our code must be obeyed.[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_dokuboss_07

entries.text: And so...this badge is mine to keep no more.\nI entrust it to thy care.[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_dokuboss_08

entries.text: Take this contraption, too. It contains a technique\nthat allows one to cover their foes in gunk.[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_waza_01

entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)][VAR 0x0100(0000)] is thy name,\nis it not?[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_dokuboss_09

entries.text: You have utterly bested me. But thy victory stir’d\nno bitterness within me—such was its brilliance.[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_dokuboss_10

entries.text: Don Atticus!
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_student_01

entries.text: M-my compadre?[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_dokuboss_11

entries.text: It seems this little fella has been dying to speak\nwith you face-to-face.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_nelke_01

entries.text: Don Atticus, please, hear what I have to say!\nI only need a moment!
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_student_02

entries.text: [EMPTY 61]
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_dokuboss_12

entries.text: [EMPTY 61]
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_nelke_02

entries.text: Whatever brought you all the way here?[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_dokuboss_13

entries.text: I came to help you!
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_student_03

entries.text: If you don’t start going to class again, you’ll be\nexpelled from the academy, right?
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_student_04

entries.text: When the other kids at school and I were getting\nbullied real bad, you and the rest of Team Star\r\nsaved us!
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_student_05

entries.text: Thanks to that operation you carried out,\nwe were all able to go to school again!
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_student_06

entries.text: If you got expelled for being the good guys,\nthat’d be the worst thing ever!
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_student_07

entries.text: Forgive me...[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_dokuboss_15

entries.text: Haven’t you heard anything from the big boss...?
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_student_08

entries.text: Nay, we’ve heard not a whisper since that\nfateful day...[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_dokuboss_16

entries.text: Without the big boss, Team Star cannot carry on.\c\nAnd without the team, the bright and merry\nstudent life we seek lies beyond our reach![VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_dokuboss_17

entries.text: We’ve no choice but to defend our bases till\nthe big boss returns to us![VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_dokuboss_18

entries.text: You evidently trust this big boss of yours a great\ndeal. Who exactly are they?[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_student_09

entries.text: [EMPTY 61]
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_dokuboss_19

entries.text: [EMPTY 61]
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_student_10

entries.text: In truth, not one of us has met them in the flesh.[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_dokuboss_20

entries.text: [EMPTY 61]
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_student_11

entries.text: By their own word, they are a recluse. As with the\nrest of us, ’twould seem bullying was to blame.[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_dokuboss_21

entries.text: That’s awful...
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_student_12

entries.text:
Though their name and face be unknown to us,
they are nonetheless our precious comrade.\c
Our only choice is to maintain our vigils from
the bases, awaiting the day of their return.[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_dokuboss_22

entries.text: So that’s why you don’t go to school...
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_student_13

entries.text:
But...but still! Don’t ever think that Team Star is
all you have, Don Atticus!\c
You’ve got a lifelong compadre in me—and don’t
you forget it!
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_student_14

entries.text: My compadre...[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_dokuboss_23

entries.text: [EMPTY 61]
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_student_15

entries.text: [EMPTY 61]
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_student_16

entries.text: I owe you a great debt.[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_dokuboss_24

entries.text: It seems we’re one step closer to the truth behind\nTeam Star’s truancy—and the bullying at the\r\nacademy. But more importantly...[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_nelke_03

entries.text:
I can’t believe I had no idea about these issues
the students are struggling with...\c
They have friendships they hold dear and reasons
for acting as they do. I just couldn’t see it.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_nelke_04

entries.text: It’s shameful how oblivious I’ve been.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_nelke_05

entries.text: [EMPTY 61]
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_student_17

entries.text: Haaah... I believ’d Team Star to be the one and\nonly treasure in my life...[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_dokuboss_25

entries.text: Methinks I may have been mistaken.[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: ajito_doku_040_dokuboss_26
